method: Tokenize shared HEADER fragments and exact SCREEN separately; namespace and load-mode placeholders are fixed for counting, fragment boundaries can differ by a few tokens. Normalize namespace only for exact nonblank-code-line overlap.

ordering.recommended: Use seeded shuffled minibatches in MLX. Optional supplied indices mix exact proportions in blocks of 10; do not use ordering for a train/test split.

leakage_contract.validation: Independent authored development tasks only; no source prompt or near-template random holdout
leakage_contract.references: Gold outputs independently compiled before validation loss use
leakage_contract.retention: Compare frozen 16 code +48 plan tasks against retained specialized adapters through their existing inference contracts; assess fresh C# adapter separately and do not replace defaults
leakage_contract.qualification: Learning repeated scaffold or reducing training loss does not establish unseen-family accuracy or physical qualification
